'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike Gemme LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Gemme]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
